title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a high‑energy show with crisp vocals, a smoking Little Red Rooster and stellar Cassidy performances.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly clear, well‑balanced sound for an audience source—vocals are distinct and Jerry's slide guitar shines. The concert itself is praised as solid from start to finish, highlighted by an inspired Little Red Rooster and one of the best Cassidys on tape, with Brent’s keyboards adding extra sparkle.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are strongly positive, noting both high‑quality audio and an outstanding performance; the weighted average yields a rating in the upper‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report great overall sound quality, clear vocals and crisp capture of Jerry's guitar despite being an audience recording; no significant noise or dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently solid from start to finish with a tight, high‑energy feel throughout the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Slide guitar praised; guitar tone described as great and clear.
